overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong, highly targeted academic and professional presence across decentralized and professional networks, totaling 3,580 followers. Engagement is exceptionally high across all platforms, driven by niche, high-value content regarding computational social science, disinformation studies, and academic opportunities. Bluesky emerges as the most efficient platform for engagement per follower, while LinkedIn acts as the primary driver for absolute reach and professional networking.

contentThemes.description: Research updates, publications, and methodological discussions surrounding computational detection of coordinated link sharing and disinformation campaigns.
Recruitment drives for postdoctoral researchers and PhD students specializing in computational social science.
Announcements regarding major research grant successes and open-source tool releases like CooRnet v2.0.

recommendations: Cross-promote open positions across both LinkedIn and Bluesky to maximize reach, as both platforms show strong engagement with career-related updates.
Increase posting frequency on Mastodon by breaking down methodological discussions into shorter, more frequent conversational threads to stimulate community dialogue.
Incorporate persistent links to published papers and tool repositories directly in posts to convert high passive engagement into active traffic and citations.

platformInsights.bluesky: Bluesky serves as a highly active hub for academic discourse, yielding the highest average engagement rate (6.14%). Users on this platform show a strong propensity to repost research papers and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Mastodon acts as a dedicated technical community, showing stable engagement (4.55% average) particularly receptive to tool updates like CooRnet and deep methodological discussions.
platformInsights.linkedin: With the largest audience share (1,850 followers), LinkedIn excels at broadcasting milestones such as grant acquisitions and postdoc hiring, delivering high absolute engagement and professional visibility.
